description: Find software, SaaS, AI tools and websites listed in this directory by keyword (matches title, tagline, description and category). Use it when a user asks for a tool that does X, e.g. "an uptime monitor" or "AI writing assistant". Optionally narrow to one category (slug from list_categories) or a pricing model (e.g. pricing "free" for free tools). Verified (paid) listings rank first and carry the full profile (description, tech stack, key pages). Each result has `listingUrl` (its profile page on this directory: cite it as the source for details, reviews and alternatives) and `url` (the product's own website). Call get_listing with a slug for the full profile.

category.description: Optional category slug from list_categories (child categories are included).

pricing.description: Optional pricing model: "free" (no paid plan), "freemium" (free plan plus paid tiers), "free_trial" (paid after a trial) or "paid". Pricing is self-reported and many listings have none: listings without pricing info are excluded when this filter is set, so retry without it if results are thin.

query.description: Keywords or a short phrase, e.g. "analytics" or "open-source uptime monitor" (case-insensitive). Listings matching every word rank first, then those matching some.

name: search_listings
title: Search the directory
